verdict.rationale: Datalab documents converting images and scans into Markdown, HTML or JSON, and its open-source Marker handles images in all languages, so it has a direct OCR capability for scanned and photographed documents. Nothing in the evidence addresses accuracy on hard inputs. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamps, and low-quality or noisy scans; accuracy benchmarks on scanned or photographed documents; independent hands-on corroboration on degraded scans.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included
